hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.mjs|*.css) node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/strip-blank-lines.mjs" "$f" ;; esac; npx --no-install prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f"; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.mjs) npx --no-install eslint --fix "$f" ;; esac; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
